status: Offline sensor, cooling and CPU/GPU/display ownership trace completed. Sensor discovery and power retry lifecycle corrected; full stock Android policy parity is not asserted.
address_convention: Ghidra virtual addresses in the explicitly selected ARM64 v8A program.

native_policy.decision: Retain the native controller and calibration. No raised thresholds or disabled throttling are introduced.

selection.main: 0x118b00; assembly fallback used after decompiler timeout.
selection.persisted_selector: /data/vendor/thermal/.permanent_tp; main reads a bounded name, trims trailing whitespace and checks thermal/disable prefixes before dispatch.
selection.fallback: main 0x11c2dc..0x11c2e4 passes the literal thermal.conf at 0x10458a to change_policy.
selection.policy_switch: change_policy 0x136b10 rejects thermal_options.conf and direct sub-policy selection, uses thermal_options_checker for registered defaults, otherwise calls exe_change_policy 0x1118e0.
selection.scope: Stored-policy/fallback and skin-parser path, not every command-line or alternate-policy branch. The current phone was not queried.

thermal_core.physical: get_tz_temp 0x111220 reads thermal_zoneN/temp as integer values.
thermal_core.virtual: get_virtual_tz_temp 0x110fc0 supports maximum or weighted-sum computation with a gate sensor and hysteresis; unresolved dependency returns -274000.
thermal_core.output: Reserved virtual indices may publish U_VSENSOR records to /sys/kernel/thermal/user_vsensor; this is distinct from Honor shell caches.

dubaid.discovery: HnThermalUtils::FindThermalZone 0x386b6c matches type names case-sensitively, selects the first match and resolves its temp path.
dubaid.raw_read: RealSensor::DefaultSensorUpdateValue 0x38e050 reads an integer without scaling and tracks read/fd failures.
dubaid.conversion: ReportTemperature::UpdateSensorTemperature 0x388994 applies the configured operation; division by 1000 stores truncated whole Celsius and a milli-Celsius remainder with CLOCK_BOOTTIME timestamps.
dubaid.distinction: Reporter filtering, shell estimation and Android HAL severity are separate stages, not interchangeable readings.

lineage.unit: milli-Celsius before the stock estimator/reporter conversions
lineage.discovery_fix: A shared complete-scan routine now rejects unreadable, empty or truncated type files and directory failures before declaring uniqueness or sensor absence. Duplicate type names remain explicit; callers reject ambiguous required sources.
lineage.difference_from_stock: The port deliberately rejects ambiguous discovery instead of selecting the first matching stock zone.

threshold_callback.state: Enable is latched only when the callback returns 1; release clears the latch.
threshold_callback.failure_semantics: The native release clears its latch even when its callback reports failure; the Lineage display or power transport must not assume this proves hardware release.

general_cooler.behavior: Resolve configured cooling name and write its computed limit to cooling_deviceN/cur_state.

catm.behavior: Calculate proportional/integral terms with retained state, direction-dependent gain and configured clamps.
catm.parameter_base: g_catm at 0x160730; byte offsets in this pinned binary only.
catm.parser_order: Read configured values and CPU/GPU/APU ATC nodes; disabled ATC restores all three caps to configured maximum. Enabled ATC clamps against atc_max_target_tj; an optional GPU override and debug path are distinct. Recompute maximum and coefficients, then register tskin_control.
catm.decision_order: Below the board trip: reset integral and return maximum. Otherwise accumulate target-current error, clamp integral, apply proportional and integral terms around steady, then clamp the result to minimum/maximum. Falling-temperature gain does not amplify negative error.
catm.pinned_result: The pinned maximum and minimum both equal 105000, so the returned target is fixed at 105000 despite internal integral state. This is not evidence that 105 C is a shell-temperature limit.
catm.native_validation: tests/emulate_stock_thermal.py: 33 cases execute the hash-pinned ARM64 routines. Additional synthetic nonfixed parameters exercise positive/negative integral, bounds and falling gain; they never alter the production configuration.

targets.behavior: Suppress unchanged targets; apply independent target caps unless bypassed. Publish CPU/GPU/NPU threshold notifications in Celsius for non-sentinel targets.

hint_coordination.owner: Native perf_lock_acq/perf_lock_rel handle; separate from UniPerf clients 1 and 2.
hint_coordination.release: Native releases and clears its stored handle on the traced disable/release path.

android_thermal_hal.conversion: Maximum configured raw sample multiplied by 0.001 into Celsius.
android_thermal_hal.missing_sample: The accumulator starts at -274000; the valid-type return flag does not prove a successful sensor sample.
android_thermal_hal.cooling_inventory: fill_cooling_devices 0x112390 discovers cooling_deviceN/type and cur_state; reporting a cooling device is distinct from deciding its limit.
android_thermal_hal.warning: Do not substitute Android SKIN severity for the Honor shell_back display policy.

android_policy.level_engine: Stock K0 converts XML thresholds and clear thresholds by 1000; warm enter >=, clear <=. The Lineage StockThermalLevelEngine retains this boundary behavior.

soc_policy.coordination: Separate current/previous maps support residual release followed by changed policy application. Additional paths cover core isolation, CATM, refresh rate and scene-specific hints.
soc_policy.port_gate: Every field must be matched to the retained MediaTek adapter. Some stock GPU leaves contain legacy frequency-like values, whereas tag 10 expects a level index; copying the XML value is not a qualified GPU limit.

predicate_sources.modeid: ControlPlugin.m -> ThermalSceneRecog.v -> SystemInfo.w. Smart-power state 3 returns mode 100; otherwise the SystemInfo mode field defaults to 1 and changes on source event 403. This is distinct from the scene resolver modeM default 2.
predicate_sources.battery_level: i1.h/i accepts exactly two numeric bounds; lower inclusive, upper exclusive.
predicate_sources.sensor_and_trigger_temp: Both attributes are required together; the sensor name must resolve and a reading must exist. Trigger bounds scale by 1000 and use lower inclusive/upper exclusive comparison.
predicate_sources.typeid: ControlPlugin.s resolves scene type through r.U, including ordered prefix-wildcard rules and the previous-game-scene special case; this is not the raw application-classifier result.
predicate_sources.outdoor: warm_shell_outdoor level configuration has its own outdoor=1 qualification.

soc_policy.aggregation: Select the last eligible ordinary/dynamic item per cluster before traversing its qualified leaves. Primary and secondary policy maps have key-specific override/AND rules; do not flatten leaves before item selection.
soc_policy.merge: Ordinary CPU maxima choose numeric minimum; reverse-ordered GPU/isolation/boost keys choose maximum. Mode-dependent AND-key merging reverses this selection and requires both primary/secondary keys.
soc_policy.release_and_readiness: e1.x emits zero for keys absent from the new map, removes them from the old map, then sends changed values. e1.s resets registered keys and clears cached state. First readiness transition on sys.cpu.uniperf.ready or elapsed time >180 seconds clears the old map and reapplies new values.

cpu.4: middle soft maximum on three-cluster path, kHz
cpu.7: prime soft maximum on three-cluster path, kHz

mtk_dispatch.gpu_10: Driver performance-level index; zero/invalid inputs resolve to native default maximum index 0. XML values 702000/520000 are not valid level indices.
mtk_dispatch.boost_57: e1 sends a separate single-tag request; DoPerfSetConfig accepts that special case without producing a resource action.
mtk_dispatch.catm_125: H0.p uses client 2 tag 125 when no dynamic junction target is active; its other MTK path writes TTJ for CPU/GPU/APU together.
mtk_dispatch.tsens_protected: Dispatches H0.s rather than frequency tag 0; its direct node-map path is Qualcomm-qualified, not a generic MTK CPU minimum.
mtk_dispatch.refresh_rate: e1.A/B0.m delivers refresh_rate plus owner temperature through its service wrapper; B0.f deduplicates rate and uses 0/-1 when the secondary-game state suppresses the cap.
mtk_dispatch.ownership: Use the retained native adapter arbitration. Never replace the client-1 power map while attempting to apply client-2 thermal leaves.

soc_policy.implementation_boundary: The current Lineage publisher implements the qualified display subset. No full replacement of HAware client-2 SoC scene policies is claimed. Unsupported tags and legacy GPU frequency values must not be copied as new driver limits.

android_policy.lineage: Display scene selection, reporter epochs, level hysteresis and seven display controls are already present. The CPU/GPU thermal-policy adapter review is still open.

host_tests: Pinned native CATM and generic threshold callbacks: 33 emulated cases; driver and log calls intercepted
Current repository seven display controls: 42 checks
Current repository metadata loader: 120 assertions using Android org.json and the pinned payload
Current repository warm/cold level engine: 174 checks
CPU/GPU power policy and controller tests, plus 7 configuration-generator tests
validation.hardware_effect: Not tested in this offline phase.

remaining: Hardware temperature accuracy, throttling effect, performance and power-loss behavior are not established by host tests.
A separate full HAware SoC scene-policy port would need qualified mode/foreground/secondary context and supported MTK dispatch; it is not implemented by the display subset.

coordination_review.sensor_to_display: Complete, sequenced shell/USB/battery batches advance reporter and level history even when scene context is unavailable. An invalid source resets its epoch; previously accepted display caps remain until a qualified replacement.
coordination_review.thermal_native: thermal_core retains its own perf handle and TTJ/cooling-device control; do not use the display SKIN severity as its board-temperature input.
coordination_review.power: DevicePowerService owns client 1; camera/non-normal audio releases its CPU/GPU votes. Intent generation now invalidates stale retries even when returning to a cached request.
coordination_review.display: Seven qualified channels use their own value domains, owner temperatures and release commands. Context/registration failure holds pending publication; it does not manufacture a release.
coordination_review.charging: Retain stock charging policy and thresholds. No charging tuning is included.
